name: papergarden
original_description:
papergarden turns ChatGPT into a picture book studio. Describe the book you have in mind: ChatGPT writes the story and illustrates every page, and papergarden lays out the pages and checks each one for printing. Then order it as a printed hardcover, delivered to your door.

Make a personalized children's book with your child as the hero, a bedtime story, or a birthday or holiday gift. Make a book for a big moment: a new baby brother or sister, the first day of school, moving house, a first visit to the dentist. Or turn family memories into an illustrated storybook: a trip to grandma's, a holiday at the beach, the day your dog joined the family.

It works for other illustrated books too: an ABC or counting book, a book of poems, a short comic, an illustrated family recipe book, or a story you wrote yourself and want to see in print.

You see the book take shape in the chat, page by page. Ask for changes at any time, from a new ending to a different picture; every version is kept. When it's ready, order an 8.5 x 8.5 inch hardcover of 24 to 84 pages.
